findings.claim_broken: The new docstring says 'anything but the full shape (a whole 40-hex commit, sha256:<64 hex>) is refused ... in every mode'. The malformed sets test only values too short, wrong case or unprefixed. Nothing longer than the full shape is tried, and nothing with trailing text. A rule that accepts over-long or suffixed values passes every test that references the shapes. The shipped code is correct (fullmatch with exact counts), so this is a test gap only. Downstream it fails closed, because E4B compares the whole sha, so it is not blocking.
